sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time: 2026-11-22 17:27 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-11-22 through 2026-11-22. Ranking basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains, ranked using supplied signal scores as secondary momentum evidence; GitHub REST metadata corroborated.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Coding-agent infrastructure and practical agent skills dominate today’s list: Claude-BugHunter (+1,721; signal score 8.451), Firecrawl (+910; 7.815), and Superpowers (+785; 7.667) lead the supplied candidates. A second clear thread is turning ordinary software and media workflows into agent-usable tools, from CLI-Anything to Stitch Skills and AutoClip.

sections.title: Top Repositories
sections.content: Ten repositories ranked by the supplied daily signal scores and corroborated with GitHub REST metadata and current default-branch READMEs.

sections.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
sections.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
sections.why_notable: Strongest supplied daily momentum signal; README describes a layered security workflow with auditable disclosed-report patterns, scope discipline and reporting. README says 83 skills versus 82 in the signal description.
sections.unique_caveat: README currently says 83 skills, while signal description says 82; fast-moving project count.

sections.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
sections.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.
sections.why_notable: Second-highest supplied signal; README spans local MCP/web extraction, self-hosting and hosted search/data access.

sections.title: obra/superpowers
sections.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
sections.why_notable: Third-highest supplied signal; README details spec, design, implementation planning, TDD and subagent execution across agent harnesses.

sections.title: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3
sections.description: The only downloader you need. 下载器的集大成者。
sections.why_notable: Fourth-highest supplied signal and a consumer-software counterpoint; README lists support for multiple file-transfer and streaming protocols in one desktop app.

sections.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
sections.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
sections.why_notable: Fifth-highest supplied signal; README describes generated agent-friendly CLI harnesses and a community hub to install/manage them.

sections.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
sections.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
sections.why_notable: High daily signal; README presents an installable multi-source research skill with engagement-weighted synthesis and broad agent-host compatibility.

sections.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
sections.description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
sections.why_notable: High daily signal; README describes link-to-short-video production with editable output, plus desktop, CLI and MCP-facing workflows.

sections.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
sections.description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 124 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 112 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
sections.why_notable: High daily signal; README turns review policies into checks/playbooks and explicitly says automated scanning cannot guarantee approval.
sections.unique_caveat: README explicitly cautions that automated scans cannot guarantee App Store or Play approval.

sections.title: toeverything/AFFiNE
sections.description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
sections.why_notable: High daily signal; README describes a local-first workspace merging docs, whiteboards and planning.

sections.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
sections.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
sections.why_notable: High daily signal; README packages design/build skills and plugins using the Agent Skills open standard across coding agents.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s attention is concentrated on reusable agent capabilities: security workflows, software-development methods, web retrieval, and interfaces that let agents operate external applications. The list also includes downloading, creator tooling and a local-first workspace. Historical star-snapshot deltas were unavailable, so this is a one-day momentum snapshot, not evidence of a sustained multi-week shift.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary signal: GitHub Trending daily and supplied signals JSON. Every selected repository was checked via GitHub REST repository metadata, the default-branch commit endpoint and its current default-branch README on raw.githubusercontent.com. Daily gains and scores come from the supplied signals file. Historical snapshot deltas are unavailable because the collector could not authenticate gh; the configured web extractor also could not extract pages, so repository READMEs were fetched from GitHub raw content.
